name: npm-permission-errors
description: Fixing file permission and resource locking errors during npm installation.
problem: npm install fails with EPERM or EBUSY errors on Windows

steps: Stop all Node.js processes: `Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force`
Wait 2 seconds for processes to terminate: `Start-Sleep -Seconds 2`
Use full path to npm if PATH issues exist: `& 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.cmd' install`
If still failing, use force flag: `& 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.cmd' install --force`
